SAM 3D meshes from every frame → FoundationPose

Question the Experiment is Testing

FoundationPose: Does using a single mesh to estimate an object's pose in a video give better results than using many meshes, each estimated at the different frames?

High Level Overview

For each object in 2 Kubric MoVi-D videos, we rebuilt a separate SAM3D mesh from every frame. Running FoundationPose with all of them and keeping, per frame, the pose whose render best lines up with the image raised pose success from 71% to 81% over using one mesh throughout, so seeing the object at other times helps estimate its pose now.

Results

The third test has the best results (improving the success rate by +10%). This means that we can improve an object's pose estimate at time t by using information from observations of the object at all other timesteps (or more observations of an object are better than just one/two)
